Split the bill,
not the friendship.

Bill Breaker scans a restaurant receipt, reads every item on it, and lets your group decide exactly who owes what — no manual entry, no awkward math at the table.

Live product · mobile-first · Next.js + Firebase

Bill Breaker is an AI-powered bill splitting app that scans a restaurant bill, extracts the items and charges, and lets a group decide exactly who should pay for what.

From receipt to final split — without manually entering the entire bill.

Equal splits are almost always wrong.

One person ordered a starter, another skipped dessert, and now everyone's staring at their phone doing mental math.

01

People consume different items, but the bill treats everyone the same.

02

Someone has to retype every line of the receipt by hand into an app.

03

Tax, service charge and discounts get lumped in and rarely split fairly.

04

The person who "figures it out" ends up doing unpaid accounting for the table.

From paper receipt to fair split, in five steps.

The whole journey happens on a phone, in the time it takes the waiter to bring the check back.

01

Scan the bill

Upload a photo of the physical receipt, or a digital one, straight from the table.

02

Extraction

Bill Breaker reads the restaurant name, every item and price, CGST, SGST, service charge, discounts and the total.

03

Review and correct

Fix anything the scan got wrong before it affects anyone's share.

04

Add the group

Bring in everyone who was at the table, however many people that is.

05

Split it

Assign items, percentages, or split evenly — Bill Breaker calculates each person's exact share, tax included.

It reads the whole bill, not just the food.

Extraction covers everything a restaurant bill actually contains — not just item names and prices.

Scan→ Extract→ Verify→ Split
Restaurant name
Bill date
Items
Item prices
Quantities (where available)
CGST
SGST
Service charge / tax
Discounts
Subtotal
Grand total

Extraction isn't final until the user says so. Before anything is split, the extracted bill is shown back for review and correction — so a misread item or amount never quietly flows into someone's final total.

The user stays in control of the numbers at every step, not just the app.

From bill to split, in one look.

Spice Route

12 Mar 2026
Butter ChickenAditi₹420
Paneer TikkaRohan₹320
Veg BiryaniMeera₹280
Chicken BiryaniKabir₹340
Garlic Naan × 4Shared₹240
Cold Coffee × 2Aditi, Rohan₹300
Subtotal₹1,900
CGST (2.5%) + SGST (2.5%)₹95
Service charge (5%)₹95
Discount−₹100
Grand total₹1,990

Final split

Aditi₹660 Butter Chicken + share of naan & coffee
Rohan₹555 Paneer Tikka + share of naan & coffee
Meera₹356 Veg Biryani + share of naan
Kabir₹419 Chicken Biryani + share of naan

Shared items are split evenly among the people who ordered them; CGST, SGST, service charge and discount are then applied proportionally to each person's item total. Figures rounded to the nearest rupee.

Four ways to divide a bill, straight from the app.

This is exactly what shows up on the split screen in billbreaker.in today.

Item-wise

Assign Items

For situations where each person pays for the specific items they consumed.

New

Shuffle Pay

For groups that want the app to randomly select one person to pay the full bill.

Custom

Custom Split (%)

For situations where people want to define their own percentage contribution.

Default

Split Equally

For situations where everyone agrees to divide the bill evenly.

How the final amount is calculated.

The same logic underneath every split method above.

Items assigned to person + applicable share of taxes/charges − applicable discounts = person's final payable amount

The final bill summary reflects the CGST, SGST, service charge / service tax and discounts actually extracted from that bill — not a fixed or assumed rate.

What happens after the split. Bill Breaker calculates the exact amount each person owes. Users can then settle the amount using their preferred payment method.

What Bill Breaker is today Bill Breaker is a bill scanning, bill understanding and bill splitting product. It is not currently positioned as a bank, wallet, lending platform, or financial institution.

It starts from the receipt, not a blank form.

Traditional expense apps often start with a blank expense form. Bill Breaker starts with the actual bill.

"Who ate what, and who should pay how much?" — the question every group meal asks, answered before the check leaves the table.

Why we built Bill Breaker.

Splitting a restaurant bill becomes unnecessarily complicated when everyone orders different things. Existing solutions often require users to manually recreate the expense. Bill Breaker was built to start with the bill itself and turn it into a fair, editable split.
